case_summary: 66岁女性，当前吸烟者（50包年），病理分期IB期（T2a N0 M0）肺腺癌，行右上肺叶切除术，切缘阴性，无淋巴结受累。
分子检测显示无可靶向驱动突变（EGFR、KRAS、ALK等）及CDKN2A深度缺失；无靶向治疗指征。
分期按AJCC第5版报告；NCCN 2010要求使用AJCC第7版。所提供的指南节选未包含NSCL-3流程图的完整辅助治疗建议。
manual_review_flags: Staging edition discrepancy: patient reported as AJCC 5th edition; NCCN 2010 uses AJCC 7th edition.
Molecular testing not standard for Stage IB; results do not alter management but may be relevant for future background.
Full NSCL-3 flowchart not provided; adjuvant therapy recommendations for high-risk Stage IB require manual review of complete guideline.
